title: Introducing Spyglass: Now Live!
summary: We are thrilled to officially launch Spyglass, our innovative new tool, making powerful insights and enhanced capabilities available to all users.

title: Enhanced File Control in Your Editor
summary: Take full command of your content with our new editor features, allowing you to easily upload, remove, download, and customize the visual display of your files.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: We're thrilled to launch our new public product roadmap, providing a clear view of our past achievements, upcoming features, and future plans.

title: Upgraded Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a seamless task management experience with our newly enhanced checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and effortlessly draggable.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've refined our editor to provide a seamless and more transparent real-time collaboration experience for all users.

title: Enhanced Sharing and Collaborative Discovery
summary: We've made it easier than ever to share your ideas and collaborate with others, ensuring all relevant shared content is readily discoverable and accessible.

title: Noeko: Open for All
summary: Noeko is now completely open, inviting our community to directly contribute, gain greater control, and enjoy full transparency in our project's journey.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We are thrilled to bring Noeko to users around the world by adding comprehensive support for multiple international languages.

title: New & Enhanced Themes
summary: We are refreshing our current themes and introducing a vibrant collection of new options to elevate your visual experience and personalize your workspace.

title: Dynamic Constellation View: Unlock Deeper Insights
summary: Experience a more powerful Constellation view that helps you effortlessly explore your knowledge base and kickstart new projects with intelligent filtering by tags, time, and shared connections.

title: Dynamic Search & Curated Knowledge Collections
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint crucial information by leveraging dynamic new filtering and sorting capabilities, and save these tailored searches as personalized knowledge collections for instant, focused access.

title: Flexible Content Display Modes
summary: Discover innovative ways to structure your notes with flexible content display modes, providing a clearer and more intuitive overview of your interconnected ideas.

title: Noeko: Flexible Deployment and Premium Plans
summary: We're empowering you to choose how and where you run Noeko, with new deployment options and premium plans unlocking powerful features for teams.

title: Smarter Greetings for Every Moment
summary: Our upcoming update will ensure your homepage greeting always matches the actual time of day, creating a more precise and welcoming start to your experience.

title: Quickly Manage Items in Tags
summary: Efficiently organize your content by performing direct actions, such as removing items, right from your tag views, saving you valuable time.

title: Expand Your Content Sources
summary: Effortlessly consolidate all your valuable information by importing and interacting with a broader range of content types, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files.
